圆形轮廓按 72 段直线近似。: Circular profile is approximated with 72 linear segments.
在二维或三维编辑视图内滚动鼠标，以鼠标位置为中心缩放图形。也可使用上方 − /: Scroll the mouse wheel inside 2D or 3D viewports to zoom centered on the cursor, or use − / +, percentage, 100%, or Fit above. Scrolling outside viewports won't zoom the UI, and Ctrl + Wheel won't zoom the browser page; lists and panels scroll normally.
在画布或对象列表中点选，: Click on canvas or in object list,
在画布或对象列表中选择图形，即可调整尺寸。: Select an object on the canvas or in the list to adjust dimensions.

坐标须为有限数值，范围 ±100000 mm。: Coordinates must be finite numbers within ±100000 mm.

外部轮廓分别作为独立实体；若轮廓嵌套，请用布尔差集生成孔，不会自动猜测孔。: Outer contours extrude as separate solids; for nested contours, use Boolean Subtract to create holes instead of auto-detecting.
多条直线对共享端点给出了不同位置，请直接移动该定位点。: Multiple lines specify conflicting positions for a shared endpoint; please move the point directly.

孔与外轮廓接触或相交，无法挤出闭合实体；请调整轮廓后重试。: Hole touches or intersects the outer contour and cannot extrude a closed solid; adjust the profile and retry.
定位点 · 单击或输入 x,y · U↵撤点: Point · Click or enter x,y · U↵ Undo
定位点 · 单击或输入 x,y 放置独立点 · Ctrl 单击选中两个点后连接: Point · Click or enter x,y to place standalone point · Ctrl+Click two points to connect
定位点为 POINT、草图直线为 LINE；闭合轮廓保留标高与拉伸厚度。: Points import as POINT and lines as LINE; closed profiles retain elevation and extrusion height.
定位点或草图直线坐标无效，且不得带有拉伸高度或倒角。: Invalid point or sketch line coordinates; extrusion height or chamfer is not allowed.
定位点或连续线输入 U 并回车撤回；连续线输入 C 并回车闭合，首末线共用起点。: Type U + Enter to undo last vertex in Point/Line; type C + Enter in Line to close back to start point. In Polygon (P), U undoes a vertex and C closes the face. Press empty Enter/Space or Right-Click to finish; Esc cancels uncommitted preview and keeps placed segments. When idle, Enter/Space repeats the last draw tool; pressing empty Enter/Space again at LINE start prompt continues from the last active line endpoint. L starts LINE immediately without Enter. Middle-drag or Alt+Left-drag to pan; use mouse wheel or toolbar controls to zoom.
定位点请输入绝对坐标 x,y，或单击画布。: Enter absolute coordinates x,y or click on the canvas to place a point.

支持 ASCII DXF 的定位点（POINT）、同标高直线（LINE）、闭合直: Supports ASCII DXF POINT, coplanar LINE, closed LWPOLYLINE, and CIRCLE. Points and lines import as zero-thickness sketch entities; default height applies to closed profiles only. Outer closed loops extrude separately; ExtrudeCAD-exported profiles restore single inner holes. DWG and STEP are unsupported.
